objections: The release is area x area x hour band; stops are mapped to 21 coarse areas inside the controller before publication, so merging rare stops into 'other' protects nothing in the published cells while it detaches those boardings from their area and biases the OD matrix (MOB-U1).
Home-stop singling out is handled by area aggregation plus small-cell suppression/DP on the output, not by per-stop merging on the internal tap table.
